bottomLine: Coast MSA renewal approved by Spend Control with funding transferred to Capital Markets; administrative sign-off is the final remaining hurdle.
Legal redlines on E6 Demo Assets now pose a critical risk to deals and demonstrations scheduled for next week.
Demo Services goals recalibrated against new Commercial OKRs, prioritizing high-margin recurring revenue and ACV conversion.
Engagement for a Coast Enterprise Agreement initiated with Vendor Management/Finance; kickoff meeting scheduled for Feb 11.
SGO 'Champions' program launched to integrate ambassadors into central demo requirements and open sessions.
Azure AI Endpoint requests for CLO are currently stalled by internal infrastructure-as-code and cloud identity processes.
Governance framework and asset flow design (Coast, Synthesia, Tiled) mandated as a prerequisite for SKO readiness.
Team-wide mandate issued for AI Agent training to ensure full proficiency in bot creation and maintenance.
bluf.background:
Operational pivot toward 2026 Commercial OKRs focusing on strategic product mix.
Procurement and legal negotiations are the primary gates for immediate demo execution.
Shift from transactional demo support to a scalable 'Champion' model and automated AI enablement.

Coast renewal risk is significantly reduced following funding alignment, though E6 legal blockers have increased in severity.
Strategic alignment with Commercial leadership is strong following goal redefinition.
Technical infrastructure (Azure) is currently the primary bottleneck for AI-led initiatives.
bluf.recommendation:
Finalize Coast MSA signature immediately to avoid disruption at CKO.
Escalate E6 redline negotiations to prevent deal slippage next week.
Prioritize internal IT tickets for Azure AI Endpoints to unblock CLO development.
